text: じつは……　レッドに　おねがいが　あるんじゃ　ちょっと　ついて　きてくれ！

structure.jp: レッドに　おねがいが　あるんじゃ
structure.en: I have a favor to ask of you, Red

structure.jp: ちょっと　ついて　きてくれ！
structure.en: come along with me for a moment!

patterns.name: 〜のだ
patterns.explanation: のだ at the end gives the feel of explaining something; ん is の shortened and じゃ is the old-man way of saying だ. おねがいが　あるんじゃ = 'the thing is, I have a favor to ask'.

patterns.name: 〜てくれ
patterns.explanation: てくれ after a verb is a blunt, friendly request to do something for the speaker. ついて　きてくれ = 'come along with me'.

patterns.name: 〜てくる
patterns.explanation: A て-form verb plus くる says the action is done moving toward or along with the speaker. ついて　きてくれ = 'come following me'.
